Whether the stated 30-35% incremental fall-through finally reaches the CONSOLIDATED margin line in 2027-28 as the cost-optimization program lands - the 2026Q2 print made this sharper, not softer: the quarter's headline adjusted-OP margin expansion was 110bps of one-off IEEPA tariff refunds, ex-which the CFO says margin "came in pretty much in line with the guidance", while FY2024-FY2025 adjusted-EPS growth was carried substantially by a non-repeatable tax step-down (23.3% to 19.9%, incl. a $21M one-off Separation tax-indemnification benefit) on operating profit that grew only ~5.7% in FY2025.
